intro: Renee Lauer serves as the innkeeper of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, offering shelter, food, and drink to travelers passing through Tirisfal Glades. In life, she was a zealous Scarlet Crusade captain whose violent past ended in a Forsaken counterattack that claimed her life and her nephew's.

p: Before her undeath, Renee was an accomplished captain in the Scarlet Crusade. Convinced that Lordaeron belonged strictly to the living and to humans, she readily slew non-humans without remorse. Her fanaticism unravelled when relatives of her victims tracked her camp down for revenge. Although her nephew Stefan intervened, the skirmish drew the attention of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras. The Forsaken host wiped out the camp, killing Stefan and raising Renee into undeath. Traumatized by how her crusade brought ruin upon her own kin, she abandoned martial life entirely to run the Gallows' End Tavern, determined to nurture rather than slaughter.

Rather than seeking vengeance against the Forsaken who struck her down, Renee directs her regret toward the fanaticism that doomed her family. Whenever captive Scarlet Crusaders or travelers end up in Brill, she shares her history to caution them against senseless hatred. She views the Crusade's dogma as an endless cycle of slaughter that guarantees only grief. While zealots rarely welcome her counsel, Renee persists in trying to convince them, offering hospitality and patient words to captive and patron alike.
